closed.body: This report is finished. Any points it earned are in your ledger under My Kartavya.
closed.title: Closed — thanks for seeing it through

needsEvidence.body: The officer reviewing your report couldn't act on the evidence so far. Add another photo and it goes straight back to them.
needsEvidence.note: The resolution clock is paused while this waits on you — the time you take isn't counted against the city's target.
needsEvidence.title: A clearer photo is needed

rejected.body: An officer decided this wasn't a civic issue they could act on. Rejection is final for this report — if the problem is real and ongoing, file a fresh one with clearer photos.
rejected.title: This report was rejected

reopened.body: An administrator is weighing up your evidence. If they uphold the dispute it goes back to an officer to fix; if not, it closes here. Nothing is needed from you in the meantime.
reopened.title: Your dispute is being reviewed

resolved.body: An officer marked this resolved. You're the one who can verify it on the ground — confirm the fix to close it, or dispute it if the problem is still there.
resolved.note: Confirming credits your Civic Service Points. If nobody confirms, the city closes it automatically after its timeout — and that path credits no points at all.
resolved.title: Is this actually fixed?

unresolvable.body: The zone office concluded this can't be fixed through the complaints process. It stops here.
unresolvable.title: Marked unresolvable

waiting.assigned: Officer #{{officerId}} has this one. We'll ask you to confirm as soon as they mark it fixed.
waiting.queued: Your report is in the zone queue. We'll ask you to confirm as soon as an officer marks it fixed.
waiting.title: Nothing needed from you right now

actors.admin: Oversees every zone, sets SLAs, rules on disputes.
actors.citizen: Reports what's broken, with a photo and a pin on the map.
actors.officer: Verifies the evidence, does the work, posts the update.

landing.closingTitle: Something in your ward needs fixing?
landing.heroText: Kartavya turns a photo of a civic problem into a transparent, accountable record — from the first report to the final fix.
landing.journeyNote: Not fixed properly? Citizens can reopen it. Evidence doesn't hold up? Officers can reject it. Every branch is recorded.

trust.aiText: Photo screening assists triage and steps aside gracefully when it's unavailable.
trust.auditText: Every status change is a permanent, append-only record.
trust.privacyText: Officers never see who filed a complaint — only the evidence.
